{{Top|leg}}
'''Nanotechs''' were microscopic [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were used to quickly repair cracks and fissures in structures. [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] fused [[Nanotechnology/Legends|nanotechnology]] with bioengineered [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] to create his [[Mazariyan]] citadel on [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]]. When his fortress was [[Battle of Xagobah (Clone Wars)|besieged]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], nanotechs were used to maintain the fortress's structural integrity during the assault. After many weeks the damage was too great for the nanotechs to keep up with and the structure began to crumble.
